notes.title: Small fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where achievements don't update until you restart the game (maybe) and made arcade mode a little easier.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
-Added arcade mode
-Added 3 new pill types which are exclusive to arcade mode
-Added shotgun and time freeze powerups
-Added a music volume setting
-Added an information page in the menu which replaces the tutorial
-Added achievements
-Added a page to view your scores in the menu
-Powerup icons now fade as they're about to run out

notes.title: Small particle effects and sounds update
notes.content:
-Changed the pill death particles to explode outward instead of falling to the ground
-Added particles to the purple phase bullets
-Added firing sound effects to all bullets
-Made the border a little smaller so you can't walk on the edge anymore

Future updates with more pills, modes, and powerups are planned.
